flags: Gate facts: posted $45 regular (under $50), $60 super. Good Sam directory gs false. No gateway within 40 km (Cuyahoga Valley NP 81 km). Presence: own site with posted rates, phone reservations. Google Maps 4.7/341.
Long-stay: monthly $900 and season $4,500/$5,400 are sold; the map labels sites C-M 'Seasonal' (11 sites), others nightly. Test 2 passes (nightly posted), test 4 passes.
Count conflict: amenities and FAQ say 112; the Site Layout page says '118 beautiful spots'. Kept 112.
No comfort stations at all: every guest must be self-contained. EKKO is; worth knowing.
Pin on TR 367 at the entrance, about 240 m from the middle of the site rows (about 40.5508,-81.7850): within tolerance.
